title: Emergency Flood & Housing Relief (DEMO DATA — NOT OFFICIAL)
summary: Immediate temporary shelter funding and home repair grants for citizens affected by severe flooding.
description: Provides up to 3 months of emergency rental assistance and one-time emergency grants for structural damage caused by natural floods.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: State Licensing Bureau or National ID center

document_requirements.document_name: Proof of Property Damage / Evacuation Notice
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Local emergency inspector or disaster response team

title: Low-Income Household Support Allowance (DEMO DATA — NOT OFFICIAL)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Welfare & Family Support
summary: Monthly financial assistance grant for low-income families and jobseekers.
description: Provides financial stipend and nutritional assistance vouchers for households earning under the national poverty line.
